A business under AED 50m needs e-invoicing if it's in scope. In-scope businesses below that level must appoint an Accredited Service Provider by 31 March 2027 and implement by 1 July 2027. Businesses dealing only with consumers are outside the system until a further Ministerial decision (Ministerial Decision No. 244 of 2025, Arts. 5(1)(b) and 5(2); mof.gov.ae, checked 2 Nov 2026).

When provider quotes arrive, we'd compare:
• How the connector fits your ERP and every entity
• Pricing basis: per invoice or flat, set-up and annual
• Onboarding time and support levels
• Exit terms if you switch later
